_comment: Known-good DB2 layout hashes per game version, keyed by table name.
The text exports these tools read are positional dumps: a 'Layout: <hash>'
header followed by 'id: field,field,...' rows with no column names. Tools
index those fields by position. When Blizzard adds or reorders a column the
layout hash changes and every index after the edit silently shifts, which
yields plausible-but-wrong values rather than an error.
db2_layouts.py checks the hash in each export against this table before a
tool parses it, so a shape change fails loudly and names itself.
When adding a version: convert the new dump, run
to print a block to paste here, then diff it against the previous version to
see exactly which tables need their column indices remapped.
Hashes are the layout_hash field of the WDC5 header (offset 136), which is
the same value the text exporter writes into its 'Layout:' line.
_comment_traitsubtree: traitsubtree names the hero talent trees; build_hero_talents.py reads it
_comment_haste: spellauraoptions and itemeffect are read by build_haste_buffs.py, for stacking and for item buffs
